# Synthetic, built from the documented REG_BINARY form of HardwareInformation.MemorySize
# (https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-hardware/drivers/display/). Some driver builds write
# the size as an 8-byte little-endian value instead of the older 4-byte one.
# HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}\0000
